svg.title: Base model, continued pretraining on 70% domain documents mixed with 30% chat data, then SFT. Inset: mid-training Qwen3-8B on documents drops IF-eval from 85% to 45%; the 70/30 mix keeps 79%; on-policy distillation brings it to 83%.
